weekly_theme.summary: 太陽剛進入天秤座不久，生活重心可能悄悄轉往天秤座相關的主題與氣氛。

aries.horoscope: 今天，白羊座，堅定你的信念，拒絕接受失敗。相信你的信念，並保持堅定，因為忠於自己有很大的力量。不要讓別人用他們對事情應該如何的看法來影響你。擁抱自信，不要猶豫，全力以赴，您今天可以實現的目標沒有上限。請記住，「越多越好」是你的指導原則！
aries.horoscope_en: Today, Aries, stand firm in your convictions and refuse to accept defeat. Trust in your beliefs and remain steadfast, as there’s great power in being true to yourself. Don’t allow others to sway you with their opinions on how things ought to be. Embrace your confidence and don’t hesitate to go all out—there’s no limit to what you can achieve today. Remember, "the more the merrier" is your guiding principle!

taurus.horoscope: 今天，金牛座，接受你作為思想開拓者的角色。你的想法帶有勇敢和高尚的精神，所以請務必利用這種潛力。當你集中精力時，你可能會驚訝於自己的創新能力。不妨獨自散步，反思你希望在生活中追求的重大變化。讓自己自由探索將願景變為現實的大膽策略。
taurus.horoscope_en: Today, Taurus, embrace your role as a trailblazer in your thinking. Your ideas carry a brave and noble spirit, so make sure to harness this potential. You might be astonished by how innovative you can become when you focus your energy. Consider taking a solitary stroll to reflect on the significant changes you wish to pursue in your life. Allow yourself the freedom to explore daring strategies for bringing your vision to life.

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座，今天就採取大膽而自信的方法。請明確表示您不會輕易退縮。您的想法和觀點具有重要意義，它們必須達到真正重要的人的耳朵。相信自己言語的影響力，特別是在與他人合作時。當你與周圍的人團結在一起時，有很大的機會。
gemini.horoscope_en: Embrace a bold and assertive approach today, Gemini. Make it clear that you won't easily back down. Your thoughts and perspectives hold significant weight, and it's essential that they reach the ears of those who truly matter. Trust in the influence of your words, particularly when you collaborate with others. There's great potential for opportunity when you unite with those around you.

cancer.horoscope: 今天可能感覺像是一個令人困惑的十字路口，每個人都猶豫不決。巨蟹座，不要退縮，讓其他人帶頭。如果您認識到這是您發光發熱的時刻，請自信地向前邁進。不妨稍微說明你已準備好採取行動。其他人可能不習慣看到你採取這種積極的立場。
cancer.horoscope_en: Today could feel like a confusing intersection where everyone is hesitant to proceed. Cancer, don’t hold back and let others take the lead. If you recognize that it’s your moment to shine, step forward with confidence. It might also be wise to give a little indication that you’re ready to take action. Others may not be accustomed to seeing you take such a proactive stance.

leo.horoscope_en: Now is not the time for anyone to question your perspective, Leo. The intensity of your convictions is strong, and you might find yourself pushing boundaries to express your thoughts. Exercise caution when it comes to commitments you may struggle to keep. Your passion for your beliefs could lead you to exaggerate scenarios just to emphasize your stance.

virgo.horoscope_en: Virgo, your traditional thought patterns have served you well, but now is the moment to explore fresh avenues for your ideas. Embrace bolder methods of self-expression and step outside your comfort zone. As you embark on this exciting new path, you'll discover a wealth of support cheering you on to keep moving forward.

libra.horoscope: 給朋友打個簡單的電話，就可以演變成一場關於人生更深層問題的深刻對話，天秤座。留意此刻在你腦海中盤旋的強烈思想。當閘門打開時，你可能會發現自己被情緒和想法的激增所淹沒。在表達這種能量時要小心，即使你覺得自己無法控制它。
libra.horoscope_en: A simple call to a friend could evolve into a profound conversation about life's deeper questions, Libra. Stay aware of the intense thoughts swirling in your mind at the moment. When the floodgates open, you might find yourself overwhelmed by a surge of emotions and ideas. Exercise caution in how you express this energy, even if it feels like you have no control over it.

scorpio.horoscope: 今天，天蠍座，你可能會覺得有點緊迫，需要啟動或發展一些你沒有做好充分準備的事情。這種不確定性表明，在潛入之前謹慎行事並收集更多信息是明智的。請務必確認您對情況的影響力，確保您掌握方向，而不是讓它決定您的路徑。
scorpio.horoscope_en: Today, Scorpio, you might sense a bit of urgency to initiate or develop something that you're not fully prepared for. This uncertainty suggests that it's wise to proceed with caution and gather more information before diving in. Make sure to assert your influence over the situation, ensuring you steer the course rather than letting it dictate your path.

sagittarius.horoscope_en: Today is the day to take decisive action, Sagittarius! There's a restless energy stirring inside you, pushing you to dive into your current project. You possess all the information necessary, so it's time to stop holding back. The strength of your communication is on your side. You'll navigate even the most stressful moments with grace and assurance, and your words will come effortlessly.

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，今天是為你的生活注入一些興奮的日子！如果您發現自己有點陷入困境，可能是時候更進一步突破界限了。請記住，你掌握著點燃自己熱情的鑰匙。今天有一個很好的機會來啟動新的東西，所以抓住它！不要猶豫，請徵求他人的支持，以幫助您一路走來。
capricorn.horoscope_en: Today is the day to inject some excitement into your life, Capricorn! If you find yourself feeling a bit stuck in a rut, it might be time to push your boundaries a little further. Keep in mind that you hold the key to igniting your own passion. There's a fantastic chance to kick off something new today, so seize it! Don't hesitate to enlist the support of others to help you along the way.

aquarius.horoscope_en: Today, Aquarius, you might find yourself bombarded by others eager to share their opinions and insights. Prepare for a flood of information coming your way! It's wise to absorb everything being said before you respond with your own views and feelings. However, be cautious, as the urge to debate could overshadow your ability to address the situation calmly.

pisces.horoscope: 在嘗試說服他人相信自己的觀點之前，請確保自己立足於實際情況。今天，一股原始能量在你體內冒出來，尋找一種表達自己的方式。但是，要小心踩踏，以免拉伸自己太瘦，特別是在心理挑戰方面。你渴望堅持自己的觀點，可能會模糊你對實際情況的理解。
pisces.horoscope_en: Before you attempt to convince others of your perspective, make sure you ground yourself in practical realities. Today, a surge of raw energy is bubbling up inside you, seeking a way to express itself. However, tread carefully to avoid stretching yourself too thin, especially regarding mental challenges. Your eagerness to assert your viewpoint might cloud your understanding of the actual circumstances.
